description.description: A series of frames from a video depicting a chaotic protest in the Netherlands. The video captures a massive crowd of people, many in dark clothing, clashing with the police including vehicles. Some protesters are holding flags and umbrellas while others stand in groups on a paved road lined with trees. Overlaid text on each frame provides a context for the event shown.
